title: Lesson 1.4: Security Methodology & Building a Program

story.vex: Rules with no order are just suggestions. Suggestions don't stop me. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it began: every rule now has its place, and the program actually holds together. Astro: "Policy down to standards, standards down to procedures. Nothing improvised."

Read mixed-rules.txt: four rules, written with no order. Sort each into its correct level: policy, standard, or procedure.

MIXED RULES (unsorted)
------------------------
rule-protect-crew-data     "Protect crew data." (high-level, rarely changes)
rule-password-length       "Passwords must be 12+ characters." (a specific, checkable rule)
rule-onboarding-steps      "On a cadet's first watch: assign account, set password, review AUP, log completion." (exact steps)
rule-close-unused-ports    "All unused network ports must stay closed." (a specific, checkable rule)
